nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances; written in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances; modified in approve and transferFrom.
Privileged owner address; used as whitelist key in ensure and for access checks.
Per-address sale counter; incremented on every transferFrom and read by ensure/condition.
Whitelist mapping that bypasses the sale-condition checks in ensure().
Minimum sale amount set by init(); read in condition().
Maximum sale amount set by init(); read in condition().
Maximum number of sale operations per address; read in condition().
Whitelisted trading address; set by setTradeAddress and read in ensure().
Total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant used as a whitelist entry in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender, _to and _value to transferFrom.
Internal whitelist guard checking owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balances directly and calls ensure().
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) with caller-supplied target and calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution that multiplies _value by _tos.length and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used inside ensure().
Payable constructor that sets supply, owner = msg.sender and an unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and as the implicit _from of transfer().
Low-level delegatecall executing arbitrary calldata supplied by the caller in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with raw arithmetic (no SafeMath).
total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/ensure; keys allowance, balanceOf, _onSaleNum and whitelist checks.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure/batchSend.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend.
Local aggregate amount = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index over _tos in batchSend.
Target address parameter of delegate, used as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate, forwarded verbatim to delegatecall.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Sale count parameter of init assigned to _saleNum.
Minimum sale parameter of init used to derive _minSale.
Maximum sale parameter of init used to derive _maxSale.

edges.reason: transfer() immediately delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is passed as the implicit _from argument of transfer().
Recipient parameter _to flows into transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value flows into transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the spender key of allowance.
_from keys allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum inside transferFrom.
_to is credited in balanceOf[_to] += _value.
_value drives the allowance, ensure and balance arithmetic.
transferFrom performs raw balance subtractions/additions without SafeMath.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure() requires condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist branch matches.
_from is tested against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale[_from] to bypass sale limits.
_to is compared against owner and the UNI constant in the whitelist branch.
owner address grants an unconditional whitelist bypass in ensure().
tradeAddress grants an unconditional whitelist bypass in ensure().
canSale[_from] bypasses the sale-condition enforcement.
_onSaleNum feeds the per-address sale-count bookkeeping checked around ensure().
_saleNum bounds the number of sales per address in condition().
_minSale lower-bounds the transferred value in condition().
_maxSale upper-bounds the transferred value in condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum in condition().
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
transferFrom directly mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decreases allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not the owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any ownership verification.
msg.sender is the allowance owner slot written by approve().
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the call.
owner state variable is the sole gate of delegate().
Caller-supplied address a is the target of delegatecall.
Caller-supplied bytes b is the delegatecall payload.
delegate() performs the low-level delegatecall operation.
Attacker-controlled target address reaches the delegatecall.
Attacker-controlled calldata reaches the delegatecall.
delegatecall executes arbitrary external code inside this contract's storage context, allowing re-entry into balanceOf-dependent logic.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
owner is the authorization source for init().
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init().
token parameter is scaled into _minSale by init().
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale by init().
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution.
_tos array determines the recipients and loop length of batchSend.
_value determines the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
Local total is checked against balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend.
Loop index i drives iteration over _tos in batchSend.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[_to] per recipient.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist.
owner is the authorization source for setTradeAddress().
addr parameter is written into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress which silently whitelists transfers in ensure().
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting all privileged functions to the deployer.
totalSupply is minted to the deployer in the constructor.
ensure() derives the Uniswap pair address through pairFor().
The hardcoded UNI constant is a permanent whitelist entry in ensure().

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a parameter of transferFrom/ensure that only names the balance and allowance slot being updated.
_to is a recipient parameter consumed by the same transferFrom balance update.
_value is an amount parameter feeding the unchecked balance arithmetic performed by transferFrom.
_tos is the recipient array parameter that drives the ownership-restricted batchSend loop.
total is the local result of the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
i is only the loop counter of the owner-restricted batchSend iteration.
a is the delegatecall target parameter consumed by the owner-only delegate function.
b is the raw calldata parameter executed by the delegatecall operation.
addr is the value parameter stored by the owner-only setTradeAddress setter.
saleNum is an initializer parameter assigned to _saleNum inside owner-only init().
token is an initializer parameter scaled into _minSale inside owner-only init().
maxToken is an initializer parameter scaled into _maxSale inside owner-only init().
